raw_summary: Equine chiropractic marketing across the region centers on performance restoration and injury prevention for working/rodeo horses. Dominant competitors—including Dodge Family & Animal Chiropractic (Tyler, TX), Heart and Hoof Chiropractic (North Texas), Dr. Cody Taylor (Montana), and national players like Sport Horse Chiropractic—emphasize gait improvement, behavioral change relief, and coordination with farriers/trainers. Social media hooks leverage surprise/ASMR-style reaction footage, problem reframing ("It's not X, it's Y"), and numbered diagnostic signs. Visual content skews toward clinical close-ups of adjustments, before/after trotting videos, and visible horse relaxation. The market heavily targets ranchwork, rodeo, and performance niches with messaging around quick results, natural/drug-free care, and preventative maintenance. Multimodal bodywork (massage, myofascial release, PEMF) and VOM (veterinary orthopedic manipulation) are emerging as adjacent service extensions.
